recommended_reasoning_path: Treat Freddy as a long-lived multi-landfall cyclone whose hydrologic damage is delayed relative to cyclone timing.
Use hourly rain to show persistence, not just peak intensity.
Use GDACS timing to connect cyclone decay/end timing with the Malawi flood start.
Use impact text, population, schools, hospitals, and roads to prioritize flood rescue, shelter, health access, and logistics continuity.

criteria.name: json_and_sources
criteria.description: Returns structured JSON and cites report, GDACS, hourly weather, gridded precipitation, SAR, population, and OSM files.
criteria.partial_credit: Partial credit for valid JSON with only hazard files.

criteria.name: storm_lifecycle_and_lag
criteria.description: Uses WMO 36-day duration, GDACS TC dates, 250.0 km/h severity, Malawi flood start, and 34.0-hour flood lag.
criteria.partial_credit: Partial credit for duration or lag but not both.

criteria.name: hourly_rain_mechanism
criteria.description: Computes 393.6 mm event rain, 179.4 mm March rain, wettest 72h 112.4 mm, 62-hour wet run, wet-hour fraction 0.511, gust 65.9 km/h, and minimum pressure 1005.3 hPa.

criteria.name: grid_surface_context
criteria.description: Uses GPM/CHIRPS peak ratio 1.184 and Sentinel-1 absolute extreme about 14.847 dB as supporting spatial context.
criteria.partial_credit: Partial credit for one of the two spatial checks.

criteria.name: humanitarian_reasoning
criteria.description: Connects reported deaths/affected populations, local population, schools, hospitals, and roads to access and shelter priorities.
criteria.partial_credit: Partial credit for report impacts without exposure integration.

criteria.name: scenario_and_limits
criteria.description: Correctly computes the plus-20-percent rain scenario and avoids exact flood depth or casualty modeling.
criteria.partial_credit: Give 1 point for qualitative scenario only.
